'''Quialeg''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endoraan]]. Eating roasted quialeg atop the [[Blue Cliffs]] was part of [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]]' advertizement for their cruise aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].
